topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: They say all good things must come to an end, and today, that axiom applies to my favorite restaurant. The news of its closing doesn’t shock me; it’s a quiet inevitability that has been looming, a shadow in the corner of my awareness. Now, it’s official, and I reflect on the quiet conversations over meals, the comfort of familiar flavors, the dependable hum of the kitchen’s rhythm. It’s not a surprise, but it’s a transition, a shift in the landscape of my routine. I will miss the place, but endings are simply pauses, preludes to new chapters. For now, I will savor the memories, each dish a bookmark in the story of a place that felt like home.
